headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.41
summary: Exiting the launcher now says goodbye properly: confirming Exit shows a one-second farewell note before the app closes for real.

items.text: Pressing Exit in the quit dialog now opens a fullscreen farewell note for one second, and the app then closes completely instead of lingering in the background.
The farewell note draws edge-to-edge under the display cutout, so the notch never pushes or clips it.
English locale shows the translated note "Thanks for coming", while Vietnamese keeps the deliberately accent-free "Cam on vi da den".
